assumptions_made: Using the Hugging Face fineweb dataset as the primary data source, but falling back to a local CSV file if that fails
Synthesizing binary sentiment labels for the Hugging Face dataset since it doesn't contain explicit labels
Using a simple whitespace tokenizer for n-gram extraction
Treating the Hugging Face dataset as a general-purpose text corpus suitable for sentiment analysis
Assuming the local CSV file contains appropriate text and label fields for sentiment classification
Using a fixed test split ratio of 0.25 for train/test separation
Implementing both unigram and bigram features in the same Naive Bayes framework
Using macro F1 as the secondary metric alongside accuracy
